title: A Noetherian scheme has finitely many irreducible components
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, i.e. a locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] quasi-compact scheme. Then the underlying topological space of $X$ has only finitely many irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components].
